tasks.title: Shared group-install bootstrap (seed installer, reconcile-safe, DM-established recognition)
tasks.objective: Build channels/group-install-bootstrap.ts: metadata persist, already-registered bail, group_join_onboarding dedup; installer resolved via resolvePersonIdentity createIfMissing:false (retired-alias throw = unrecognised) plus a new hasDirectConversationWithPerson repo query; recognised = register+seed installer via seedInstaller (extracted from the coordinator's register settings-write), upserting the installer as participant so reconcile keeps the approver; unrecognised = manual message only.
acceptance_criteria: Recognised installer path registers the conversation and seeds exactly [installer] as controlApprovers through applyConversationInstallToSettings + writeDesiredRuntimeSettings (never a direct conversation_approvers write).
The seeded approver survives desired-state reconcile on a fresh group (installer participant upserted at seed time; reconcile membership check unchanged).
Unrecognised (no alias, retired alias, or no direct conversation) seeds nobody, registers nothing, posts the manual-setup message once.
Dedup: a second join event for the same group posts nothing and never clobbers an existing approver list.

required_tests.id: group install bootstrap > recognised seeds installer and survives reconcile; unrecognised fails closed; dedup holds
required_tests.command: VITEST_JUNIT=1 FORGE_TEST_ID={id} npx vitest run -c vitest.unit.config.ts {path} --outputFile {report}

tasks.title: Telegram rewire + delete the DM Yes/No propagation flow
tasks.objective: Point my_chat_member at the shared bootstrap with String(update.from.id) as installer; DELETE handleTelegramGroupJoinCallback, the DM prompt send, recordPrompt machinery and the callback route (full plumbing cleanup); rewrite the telegram.test.ts group-join suite (recognised: in-group ack + seed; unrecognised: in-group guidance; no DM messages anywhere).
acceptance_criteria: Recognised Telegram installer: group registers, installer seeded, ack posted in the group via the adapter's sendMessage.
Unrecognised installer: manual-setup message in the group; no registration, no DM traffic.
No dead code remains from the DM prompt flow (handler, callback route, recordPrompt, prompt-target resolution, related tests).

required_tests.id: telegram group join > recognised installer bootstraps in-group; unrecognised gets guidance; DM prompt flow gone
required_tests.command: VITEST_JUNIT=1 FORGE_TEST_ID={id} npx vitest run -c vitest.unit.config.ts {path} --outputFile {report}

tasks.title: Slack inviter extraction, Discord manual fallback, docs + parity
tasks.objective: Slack: subscribe member_joined_channel in channel-interactions.ts; when event.user is the bot, event.inviter is the installer (absent = unrecognised); document the event + read scopes in docs/operations/slack-app-install.md. Discord: on GUILD_CREATE for an unregistered guild post the manual-setup message once (dedup via onboarding row). Teams: docs note. Add a provider parity test.
acceptance_criteria: Slack: bot invited by a DM-established person registers the channel, seeds the inviter, acks in-channel; missing inviter falls to the manual path.
Discord: first GUILD_CREATE for an unknown guild posts the manual-setup message once; reconnect refires post nothing.
Ops doc names the exact Slack manifest changes; Teams manual state documented; parity test asserts every provider claiming installer extraction implements it.

required_tests.id: provider group join parity > slack inviter bootstraps; discord manual fallback dedups
required_tests.command: VITEST_JUNIT=1 FORGE_TEST_ID={id} npx vitest run -c vitest.unit.config.ts {path} --outputFile {report}
